remaining_map.critical_coupling_finding: Phases 3,4,6 are a COUPLED WAVE, not independent as the plan's clean separation implies. The per-slot enumeration (Phase 3, N-bound variable-length lists), the per-slot direct reader (Phase 4, drop kvE2_sepSlotRank projection), and the variable-length per-slot payloads emitted by kvE2_sepHonestOrder/kvE2_sepCoincidentOrder/kvE2_sepModelOrder (Phase 6) MUST change together: a length-3 payload is not a member of an N-bound variable-length enumeration, and a per-slot reader cannot index a length-3 rank-payload without a tie. Recommended next-dispatch sequencing to stay green: (1) define the canonical owner-block slot ordering + slotIndexOf/positionOf (model-independent, from kvE2_sepSlotsLFor ++ kvE2_sepSlotsRFor); (2) grow honest/coincident/model payloads to length = owner block length, entries first reproducing the OLD rank-based values (still green, still tied); (3) then flip kvE2_sepSlotGIdx to per-slot-position reads AND the enumeration to N-bound in one green step; (4) re-prove the three membership theorems. Treat Phases 3-4-6 (+5,7) as one full-budget continuation.
